question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

18, 19, 28, 53, 102, ?
solution:
The logic followed here is :

The difference between each consecutive number is increasing by the square of odd numbers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c3f5550fb94cedfcdd4ad614eb29f59c1c69d3353ef55f2cf2d1f06a65e873b.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**183**".
